about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I'm a software developer focused on .NET and C# back-end development, also working with Angular and React on the front-end when a project calls for it. I have experience with SQL Server, MySQL, and Oracle, building integrated applications with an emphasis on clean code, best practices, and responsiveness.
about.paragraph2: Day to day, I work with ASP.NET Core, REST APIs, and relational databases, maintaining and evolving systems in production. I'm pursuing a postgraduate degree in Software Architecture to deepen my technical decision-making and engineering practices, aiming to grow as a Software Engineer specialized in .NET.
about.educationValue: B.Sc. in Computer Science | Postgraduate student in Software Architecture
about.focusValue: Deepening software architecture, REST APIs, and back-end best practices in .NET

lojaRoupas.challenge: Purchase confirmation emails: integrated an external email API to deliver the intended layout and content.

teamLunch.name: TeamLunch — Restaurant Voting
teamLunch.problem: Help teams democratically decide where to have lunch that day.
teamLunch.solution: Each employee accesses the list of available restaurants and votes for their favorite of the day.
teamLunch.challenge: Automatic vote closing: implemented a background service that closes voting at noon and displays the winning restaurant.
